changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: What a mentor attempt's dispatch fence matches: the payer, model and connection of its frozen route, and the provider observation bound to its lease epoch.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE public.mentor_attempt ADD COLUMN route_payer VARCHAR(16) CONSTRAINT ck_mentor_attempt_route_payer CHECK (route_payer IN ('WORKSPACE', 'PERSONAL_PURSE')), ADD COLUMN route_workspace_id BIGINT, ADD COLUMN route_model_id BIGINT, ADD COLUMN route_connection_id BIGINT, ADD COLUMN observed_epoch BIGINT, ADD COLUMN observed_at TIMESTAMP(6) WITH TIME ZONE, ADD COLUMN observed_reader_epoch BIGINT, ADD COLUMN observed_readers TEXT[];

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE public.mentor_attempt DROP COLUMN observed_readers, DROP COLUMN observed_reader_epoch, DROP COLUMN observed_at, DROP COLUMN observed_epoch, DROP COLUMN route_connection_id, DROP COLUMN route_model_id, DROP COLUMN route_workspace_id, DROP COLUMN route_payer
